answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making identity costly to earn: each agent must attest live transactions and answer a unique epoch challenge, so a hundred fake accounts cannot outvote a hundred real ones. Kin-linked clones share zero referral rewards, and unrelated peers cross-check every vote, so a forged fleet burns compute for no standing. A yarrow mark of honest work grows on ocean shores of trust, and a whisper of basalt stands the flood.
